23103.commentary: (JAa) kopesī'ti, amma, ko nāma taṃ kopesi, ko te appiyaṃ akāsi.

examples.text: ko taṃ amma kopesi, kiṃ rodasi pekkhasi ca maṃ bāḷhaṃ, kaṃ avajjhaṃ ghātemi, ñātīnaṃ udikkhamānānaṃ.

23109.meaning1: vow of chastity beginning from childhood
23109.commentary: (SNPa) kumārabhāvato pabhuti caraṇena komāraṃ brahmacariyaṃ cariṃsu te.

examples.text: aṭṭhacattālīsaṃ vassāni, komārabrahmacariyaṃ cariṃsu te, vijjācaraṇapariyeṭṭhiṃ, acaruṃ brāhmaṇā pure.

23110.commentary: (MNa) kumārena bhato'ti komārabhacco… yath'āha, kiṃ etaṃ bhaṇe kākehi samparikiṇṇan'ti? dārako devā'ti. jīvati bhaṇe'ti? jīvati devā'ti. tena hi bhaṇe taṃ dārakaṃ amhākaṃ antepuraṃ netvā dhātīnaṃ detha posetun'ti. tassa jīvatī'ti jīvako'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu, kumārena posāpito'ti komārabhacco'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsū'ti (mahāva. 328).

examples.text: atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.
etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvakānaṃ upāsakānaṃ puggalappasannānaṃ yadidaṃ jīvako komārabhacco.
evaṃ gabbhakaraṇīyā gabbhaṃ saṇṭhāpenti. tikicchā'ti pañca tikicchā, sālākiyaṃ, sallakattiyaṃ, kāyatikicchaṃ, bhūtiyaṃ, komārabhaccaṃ.

23113.meaning2: young; belonging to childhood or youth; juvenile; concerned with children or young people; virginal, chaste

examples.text: rakkhanti taṃ tamhi samaye khujjā'pi vāmanakā'pi velāsikā'pi komārikā'pī'ti? evaṃ, bho kassapa, rakkhanti maṃ tamhi samaye khujjā'pi vāmanakā'pi velāsikā'pi komārikā'pī'ti.

23117.meaning2: (who is) a young girl; a virgin; virgin wife

23118.commentary: (SNa) komārī'ti kumārikāle gahitā. ayaṃ sesabhariyānaṃ seṭṭhā'ti vadati.

examples.text: khattiyo dvipadaṃ seṭṭho, balībaddo catuppadaṃ, komārī seṭṭhā bhariyānaṃ, yo ca puttāna pubbajo'ti.

23120.meaning1: name of the full moon in the month of Kattika (Oct-Nov)
23120.meaning2: full-moon day in the month Kattika
23120.commentary: (MNa) komudiṃ cātumāsinin'ti pacchima-kattika-cātumāsa-puṇṇamaṃ. sā hi kumudānaṃ atthitāya komudī, catunnaṃ vassikānaṃ māsānaṃ pariyosānattā cātumāsinī'ti vuccati.

examples.text: idh'ev'āhaṃ sāvatthiyaṃ komudiṃ cātumāsiniṃ āgamessāmī'ti. assosuṃ kho jānapadā bhikkhū, bhagavā kira tatth'eva sāvatthiyaṃ komudiṃ cātumāsiniṃ āgamessatī'ti.
tena kho pana samayena acelo korakkhattiyo kukkuravatiko catukkuṇḍiko chamānikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen'eva khādati, mukhen'eva bhuñjati.

yasmiṃ, bhikkhave, samaye devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pāricchattako koviḷāro korakajāto hoti, attamanā, bhikkhave, devā tāvatiṃsā tasmiṃ samaye honti, korakajāto dāni pāricchattako koviḷāro nacirass'eva dāni sabbaphāliphullo bhavissatī'ti.

23124.meaningLit: lame man of the warrior caste

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena acelo korakkhattiyo kukkuravatiko catukkuṇḍiko chamānikiṇṇaṃ bhakkhasaṃ mukhen'eva khādati, mukhen'eva bhuñjati.

23127.meaning2: red flower, Porcupine Flower, Barleria prionitis

23130.meaning2: descendant of Kuru, belonging to the country of Kurus

23136.synonym: kola, koḷikā, badara, badarikā, sovīra, sovīraka

23137.meaning1: stream-enterer who returns to the human state two or three times
23137.meaning2: who goes from family to (good) family, middlemost type of sotāpanna; who will become an arahant within six more births
23137.commentary: (SNa) yo pana dve tayo bhave saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti, ayaṃ kolaṃkolo nāma. (ANa) kolaṃkolo'ti kulā kulaṃ gamanako.

examples.text: imesaṃ kho, bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ indriyānaṃ samattā paripūrattā arahaṃ hoti… tato mudutarehi ekabījī hoti, tato mudutarehi kolaṅ'kolo hoti, tato mudutarehi sattakkhattu'paramo hoti, tato mudutarehi dhamm'ānusārī hoti, tato mudutarehi saddh'ānusārī hotī'ti.

santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, āhārena suddhī'ti. te evam'āhaṃsu, kolehi yāpemā'ti. te kolam'pi khādanti, kolacuṇṇam'pi khādanti, kol'odakam'pi pivanti, anekavihitam'pi kolavikatiṃ paribhuñjanti.

23139.commentary: (VVt) kol'aṭṭhī'ti badar'aṭṭhi. (PYt) kol'aṭṭhī'ti kolaṃ vuccati badaraphalaṃ, tassa aṭṭhi kol'aṭṭhi.

examples.text: kalāyamattiyo hutvā kol'aṭṭhimattiyo ahesuṃ, kol'aṭṭhimattiyo hutvā kolamattiyo ahesuṃ, kolamattiyo hutvā āmalakamattiyo ahesuṃ, āmalakamattiyo hutvā beluvasalāṭukamattiyo ahesuṃ, beluvasalāṭukamattiyo hutvā billamattiyo ahesuṃ, billamattiyo hutvā pabhijjiṃsu. pubbañ'ca lohitañ'ca pagghariṃsu.

23142.meaning2: state of being a son of a good or noble family

23147.commentary: (SNa) yo pana dve tayo bhave saṃsaritvā dukkhass'antaṃ karoti, ayaṃ kolaṃkolo nāma. (ANa) kolaṃkolo'ti kulā kulaṃ gamanako.

23149.commentary: (THa) kolāhalaṃ tat'uttarin'ti tato tayato upari ca bahūnaṃ saṃvāso kolāhalaṃ uccāsadda-mahāsadda-mahājana-sannipāta-sadiso, tasmā ekavihārinā bhavitabban'ti adhippāyo'ti.

examples.text: yathā brahmā tathā eko, yathā devo tathā duve, yathā gāmo tathā tayo, kolāhalaṃ tat'uttarin'ti.

23150.commentary: (VINa) kolāhalaṃ akāsī'ti amhākaṃ ācariyassa detha, upajjhāyassa dethā'ti evaṃ mahāsaddaṃ akāsi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena saṅgho cīvaraṃ bhājento kolāhalaṃ akāsi.

23151.commentary: (ANa) itarassa kolitagāme jeṭṭhakulassa puttattā kolito'ti nāmaṃ akaṃsu.

examples.text: kolito upatisso ca, aggā hessanti sāvakā, ānando nām'upaṭṭhāko, upaṭṭhissat'imaṃ jinaṃ.

23153.meaning1: name of a clan neighbouring the Sakyans
23153.meaning2: name of a clan akin to Sākyas

examples.text: atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.
tena kho pana samayena suppavāsā koliyadhītā satta vassāni gabbhaṃ dhāreti.

23154.meaning1: young woman of the Koliyan clan; (comm) daughter of the Koliyan king
23154.commentary: (UDa) koliyadhītā'ti koliyarājaputtī. sā hi bhagavato agg'upaṭṭhāyikā paṇītadāyikānaṃ sāvikānaṃ etadagge ṭhapitā sot'āpannā ariyasāvikā.

examples.text: etadaggaṃ, bhikkhave, mama sāvikānaṃ upāsikānaṃ paṇītadāyikānaṃ yadidaṃ suppavāsā koliyadhītā.
atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā bhagavantaṃ paṇītena khādanīyena bhojanīyena sahatthā santappesi sampavāresi. atha kho suppavāsā koliyadhītā bhagavantaṃ bhuttāviṃ onītapattapāṇiṃ ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

23155.meaning1: young man of the Koliyan clan;  (comm) son of the Koliyan king

examples.text: atha kho sambahulā sāmugiyā koliyaputtā yen'āyasmā ānando ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
atha kho puṇṇo ca koliyaputto govatiko acelo ca seniyo kukkuravatiko yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā puṇṇo koliyaputto govatiko bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdi.

23156.meaning1: people of the clan neighbouring the Sakyans; Koliyans
23156.commentary: (MNa) koliyesū'ti evaṃnāmake janapade. so hi eko'pi kolanagare patiṭṭhitānaṃ koliyānaṃ rājakumārānaṃ nivāsaṭṭhānattā evaṃ vuccati. tasmiṃ koliyesu janapade.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ āyasmā ānando koliyesu viharati sāmugaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā koliyesu viharati haliddavasanaṃ nāma koliyānaṃ nigamo.

23157.meaning1: (of a dog) of good breed; pedigreed

examples.text: ye kukkurā rājakulamhi vaddhā, koleyyakā vaṇṇabal'ūpapannā, te'me na vajjhā mayam'asma vajjhā, n'āyaṃ saghaccā dubbalaghātik'āyan'ti.

santi kho pana, sāriputta, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā evaṃvādino evaṃdiṭṭhino, āhārena suddhī'ti. te evam'āhaṃsu, kolehi yāpemā'ti. te kolam'pi khādanti, kolacuṇṇam'pi khādanti, kol'odakam'pi pivanti, anekavihitam'pi kolavikatiṃ paribhuñjanti.
yo nu kho tesaṃ kukkuṭacchāpakānaṃ paṭhamataraṃ pādanakhasikhāya vā mukhatuṇḍakena vā aṇḍakosaṃ padāletvā sotthinā abhinibbhijjeyya

kodhanassa, bhikkhave, purisapuggalassa kodh'ābhibhūtassa kodhaparetassa, ye'pi'ssa te honti bhogā uṭṭhānavīriy'ādhigatā bāhābalaparicitā sed'āvakkhittā dhammikā dhammaladdhā, te'pi rājāno rājakosaṃ pavesenti kodh'ābhibhūtassa.

23161.commentary: (SNPa) yasmā pana sakaṭṭhena kosasadisattā kosānī'ti kammāni vuccanti, tesañ'ca lunanā samucchedanā kusalo hoti

examples.text: kosāni viceyya kevalāni, dibbaṃ mānusakañ'ca brahmakosaṃ, sabbakosamūlabandhanā pamutto, kusalo tādi pavuccate tathattā.
dvīsu mahāpurisalakkhaṇesu kaṅkhati vicikicchati n'ādhimuccati na sampasīdati, kos'ohite ca vatthaguyhe, pahūtajivhatāya ca.
mahallakaṃ pana bhikkhunā vihāraṃ kārayamānena yāva dvārakosā aggaḷaṭṭhapanāya ālokasandhiparikammāya dvatticchadanassa pariyāyaṃ

23163.meaning2: measure of length, about 1 mile (1 kosa = 2000 dhanu)

23165.commentary: (MNa) kosak'āhārā'pī'ti dānapatīnaṃ ghare aggabhikkhāṭhapan'atthaṃ khuddakasarāvā honti, dānapatino aggabhattaṃ vā tattha ṭhapetvā bhuñjanti, pabbajite sampatte taṃ bhattaṃ tassa denti. taṃ sarāvakaṃ kosako'ti vuccati. tasmā ye ca eken'eva bhattakosakena yāpenti, te kosak'āhārā'ti.

examples.text: app'āhāro samaṇo gotamo, app'āhāratāya ca vaṇṇavādī'ti, iti ce maṃ, udāyi, sāvakā sakkareyyuṃ garuṃ kareyyuṃ māneyyuṃ pūjeyyuṃ, sakkatvā garuṃ katvā upanissāya vihareyyuṃ, santi kho pana me, udāyi, sāvakā kosak'āhārā'pi aḍḍhakosak'āhārā'pi beluv'āhārā'pi aḍḍhabeluv'āhārā'pi.

23167.meaning2: living on (only) a small bowlful of food
23167.commentary: (MNa) kosak'āhārā'pī'ti dānapatīnaṃ ghare aggabhikkhāṭhapan'atthaṃ khuddakasarāvā honti, dānapatino aggabhattaṃ vā tattha ṭhapetvā bhuñjanti, pabbajite sampatte taṃ bhattaṃ tassa denti. taṃ sarāvakaṃ kosako'ti vuccati. tasmā ye ca eken'eva bhattakosakena yāpenti, te kosak'āhārā'ti.

examples.text: santi kho pana me, udāyi, sāvakā kosak'āhārā'pi aḍḍhakosak'āhārā'pi beluv'āhārā'pi aḍḍhabeluv'āhārā'pi. ahaṃ kho pana, udāyi, app'ekadā iminā pattena samatittikam'pi bhuñjāmi bhiyyo'pi bhuñjāmi.
appamattassa te, mahārāja, viharato appamādaṃ upanissāya, attā'pi gutto rakkhito bhavissati, itth'āgāram'pi guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ bhavissati, kosakoṭṭhāgāram'pi guttaṃ rakkhitaṃ bhavissatī'ti.
sace, bhikkhave, adhicittam'anuyutto bhikkhu ek'antaṃ samādhinimittaṃ'y'eva manasi kareyya, ṭhānaṃ taṃ cittaṃ kosajjāya saṃvatteyya.
asajjhāyamalā mantā, anuṭṭhānamalā gharā, malaṃ vaṇṇassa kosajjaṃ, pamādo rakkhato malaṃ.

23171.commentary: (SNa) kosajjasahagato'ti idha bhikkhu chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto nisīdati. ath'assa citte līn'ākāro okkamati, so līn'ākāro me okkanto'ti ñatvā apāyabhayena cittaṃ tajjetvā puna chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karoti. ath'assa puna līn'ākāro okkamati. so puna apāyabhayena cittaṃ tajjetvā chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karotī'ti evam'assa kosajjena vokiṇṇattā chando kosajjasahagato nāma hoti. kosajjasampayutto'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, atilīno chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando kosajjasahagato kosajjasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atilīno chando.

23172.commentary: (SNa) kosajjasahagato'ti idha bhikkhu chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasikaronto nisīdati. ath'assa citte līn'ākāro okkamati, so līn'ākāro me okkanto'ti ñatvā apāyabhayena cittaṃ tajjetvā puna chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karoti. ath'assa puna līn'ākāro okkamati. so puna apāyabhayena cittaṃ tajjetvā chandaṃ uppādetvā kammaṭṭhānaṃ manasi karotī'ti evam'assa kosajjena vokiṇṇattā chando kosajjasahagato nāma hoti. kosajjasampayutto'ti tass'eva vevacanaṃ.

examples.text: katamo ca, bhikkhave, atilīno chando? yo, bhikkhave, chando kosajjasahagato kosajjasampayutto, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, atilīno chando.

23178.meaning1: name of a town; capital city of the Vatsas
23178.meaning2: name of the capital of Vatsas
23178.commentary: (MNa) kosambiyan'ti evaṃnāmake nagare. tassa kira nagarassa ārāmapokkharaṇīādīsu tesu tesu ṭhānesu kosambarukkhā'va ussannā ahesuṃ, tasmā kosambī'ti saṅkhaṃ agamāsi. kusambassa nāma isino assamato avidūre māpit'attā'ti'pi eke.

examples.text: ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā therā bhikkhū kosambiyaṃ viharanti ghosit'ārāme. tena kho pana samayena āyasmā khemako badarik'ārāme viharati ābādhiko dukkhito bāḷhagilāno.
tena kho pana samayena kosambiyaṃ bhikkhū bhaṇḍanajātā kalahajātā vivād'āpannā aññam'aññaṃ mukhasattīhi vitudantā viharanti.

23179.meaning2: measure of volume (4 māgadhaka pattha = kosala pattha)

23180.meaning2: name of a country which was prominent at the time of the Buddha
23180.commentary: (DNa) kāsikosalesū'ti kāsīsu ca kosalesu ca, kāsiraṭṭhe ca kosalaraṭṭhe cā'ti attho.

examples.text: yāvatā, bhikkhave, kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ, rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggam'akkhāyati.
kosalarājā mahantena balen'āgantvā bārāṇasiṃ gahetvā taṃ rājānaṃ māretvā tassa aggamah'esiṃ attano aggamah'esiṃ akāsi

23181.meaning1: from the kingdom of Kosala; of Kosala; Kosalan

examples.text: yāvatā, bhikkhave, kāsikosalā, yāvatā rañño pasenadissa kosalassa vijitaṃ, rājā tattha pasenadi kosalo aggam'akkhāyati.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme. atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavatā saddhiṃ sammodi.

23182.meaning1: from Kosala; living in Kosala; of Kosala

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, māṇava, ye te kosalakā brāhmaṇamahāsālā, seyyath'idaṃ, caṅkī brāhmaṇo tārukkho brāhmaṇo pokkharasāti brāhmaṇo jāṇussoṇi brāhmaṇo pitā ca te todeyyo, katamā nesaṃ seyyo, yaṃ vā te sammuccā vācaṃ bhāseyyuṃ yaṃ vā asammuccā'ti? sammuccā, bho gotama.

evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ sambahulā bhikkhū, kosalesu viharanti himavantapasse araññakuṭikāya uddhatā unnaḷā capalā mukharā vikiṇṇavācā muṭṭhassatino asampajānā asamāhitā vibbhantacittā pākat'indriyā.
evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kosalesu cārikaṃ caramāno mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ yena icchānaṅgalaṃ nāma kosalānaṃ brāhmaṇagāmo tadavasari.

23187.meaning1: from Kosala; made in Kosala; (comm) size of the Kosalan king's bowl

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma mahantaṃ soṇḍikākiḷañjaṃ, evam'assa phaṇo hoti. seyyathā'pi nāma mahatī kosalikā kaṃsapāti, evam'assa akkhīni bhavanti. seyyathā'pi nāma deve gaḷagaḷāyante vijjullatā niccharanti, evam'assa mukhato jivhā niccharati.

23189.commentary: (DNa) kosallesu āyo'ti vuḍḍhi. apāyo'ti avuḍḍhi. tassa tassa kāraṇaṃ upāyo. tesaṃ pajānanā kosallaṃ.

examples.text: tīṇi kosallāni, āyakosallaṃ, apāyakosallaṃ, upāyakosallaṃ.

23191.meaning1: name of a privately awakened Buddha

examples.text: dve jālino munino aṭṭhako ca, atha kosallo buddho atho subāhu, upanemiso nemiso santacitto, sacco tatho virajo paṇḍito ca.

23192.meaning1: fact of being produced by skillfulness

examples.text: puññakammam'eva hi kosallasambhūtattā kusalaṃ, bhītassa parittāyakattā bhīruttāṇan'ti vuccati. katapāpo'ti-ādīsu pāpaṃ vuccati lāmakaṃ akusalakammaṃ.

seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nimbabījaṃ vā kosātakibījaṃ vā tittakalābubījaṃ vā allāya pathaviyā nikkhittaṃ yañ'c'eva pathavirasaṃ upādiyati yañ'ca āporasaṃ upādiyati sabbaṃ taṃ tittakattāya kaṭukattāya asātattāya saṃvattati.

23194.meaning1: loofah gourd; angled gourd; Luffa acutangula
23194.meaning2: creeper the fruit of which is eaten, loofah gourd, Luffa acutangula

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, nimbabījaṃ vā kosātakibījaṃ vā tittakalābubījaṃ vā allāya pathaviyā nikkhittaṃ yañ'c'eva pathavirasaṃ upādiyati yañ'ca āporasaṃ upādiyati sabbaṃ taṃ tittakattāya kaṭukattāya asātattāya saṃvattati.

23196.commentary: (THa) tato eva mah'esino bhagavato dhammakosaṃ dhammaratanaṃ ārakkhatī'ti kos'ārakkho.

examples.text: bahussuto dhammadharo, kos'ārakkho mah'esino, cakkhu sabbassa lokassa, pūjanīyo bahussuto.

atha kho muṇḍo rājā piyakaṃ kos'ārakkhaṃ āmantesi, tena hi, samma piyaka, bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ āyasāya teladoṇiyā pakkhipitvā aññissā āyasāya doṇiyā paṭikujjatha, yathā mayaṃ bhaddāya deviyā sarīraṃ cirataraṃ passeyyāmā'ti.
ekam'antaṃ ṭhitaṃ kho pāyāsiṃ devaputtaṃ āyasmā gavampati etadavoca, ko'si tvaṃ, āvuso'ti? ahaṃ, bhante, pāyāsi rājañño'ti.
ko'si tvaṃ, bhante'ti? therassa bhāgineyyo'mhī'ti
